scope: R5 encrypted device draft verification and existing browser regression

tests.name: M5 invoice metadata and PDF isolate participants and never create a second placement
M5 non-hired and unknown IDs have no invoice
M5 notification cursor and runtime RLS expose only recipient organization and always unsent
M5 full browser flow reaches invoice and unsent notification without sending mail
M5 long Japanese and markup names remain complete and escaped in invoice HTML
M5 invoice HTML has no PDF service dependency or raw PDF fallback
M5 revoked share removes employer PDF and plaintext while agency retains invoice
M5 internal renderer refuses missing key and caller-controlled HTML URL or extra schema
M5 expired session clears invoice metadata and rendered blob
R5 offline ciphertext survives real browser restart and reauthentication, then syncs without restoring confirmation
R5 lost business response resolves committed outcome after browser restart without another candidate
R5 other account cannot decrypt or display this profile unsynchronized input
R5 old key restores and reencrypts under current key; revoked version never restores
R5 tampered ciphertext and expired server draft are refused, not erased or replayed
R5 IndexedDB failure is not reported as durable and blocks business submission
R5 concurrent tab candidates remain distinct without overwriting typed input
R5 not-recorded intent waits for confirmation and reuses original operation instead of a new key
R5 durable draft-wide tombstone refuses a delayed crypto write from another tab
R5 uncertain draft mutation is replayed before syncing the newer local input
R5 opener-cloned sessionStorage gets a separate tab identity and preserves both inputs
R5 discard creates a durable marker before any local slot and rejects its delayed first write
R5 inactive form resolves a committed pending receipt from the list without decrypting or replaying it
R5 slow first initialization shares the serial save queue and never rolls back newer input
S5 encrypted PDF and XLSX browser journey reaches immutable sharing and invoice HTML
S5 retained internal invoice PDF matches authorized HTML values without browser delivery
S5 stale definitions load mismatch and update failure reject encrypted shared pages and submit
S5 cross-document derivative substitution is refused without raw fallback
S5 browser context loss after stored response restores same receipt without a second PUT
S5 browser loss before PUT requires file reselection and new attempt with the same document
S5 terminal receipt expiry does not reauthorize resend complete or recreate jobs
S5 small batch and 10MiB browser uploads record bounded phase latency without a fabricated SLA
S5 real rejected receipt becomes a seven-day tombstone in the browser without another upload
M4 draft hidden from employers; submit atomically freezes candidate job and selected PDF
M4 direct IDs and runtime RLS isolate all six new tables without privileged shared reads
M4 input CSRF role and failed submissions leave no snapshots events or idempotency residue
M4 same-key submit and transitions replay once even after sharing is revoked
M4 E_SHARED permits submitted screening rejected and hired; terminal revoke preserves placement
M4 status table rejects invalid transitions and duplicate active recommendations
M4 concurrent versions serialize selection against revoke without restoring shared content
M4 job lock orders close before submit and rejects stale candidate or archived submissions
M4 list pagination filters and active share revocation never expose candidate metadata
M4 browser creates and submits a preview; employer selects then loses shared UI and direct PDF access
M4 browser lost draft response retries the original key once and retains conflict input
S4 inventory preserves old PDF/shared selection and rejects unprepared views
S4 backup crypto preserves large pipe output and rejects tag or context tampering
S4 cold backup authenticates DB original files old keys and AV definitions
S4 mapping adds ciphertext then resumes after old original key loss and worker failure
S4 migrated selected version renders with no raw fallback or framework errors
S4 current key policy denies migrated views and shares without rewriting snapshots
S4 cutover drains old admission and explicitly quarantines unmigrated records
S4 tampered backup refuses authentication before creating a restore target
S4 old keys DB encrypted blobs and selected snapshots restore to a new isolated instance
